reasoning_trace.value: The paper presents a system model for optical IRS-aided indoor visible light fingerprint localization. The system consists of multiple LEDs, optical IRS units, and photodiodes (PDs). The LEDs are used as both illumination sources and signal transmitters, while the optical IRS units are used to reflect the light signals to enhance the localization accuracy. The PDs are used to capture the optical signals and measure the received signal strength (RSS) values.
